briefdescription.para: Adds an entropy source to poll (Thread-safe if MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is enabled)

parameterdescription.para: Minimum required from source before entropy is released ( with mbedtls_entropy_func() ) (in bytes)
MBEDTLS_ENTROPY_SOURCE_STRONG or MBEDTLS_ENTROPY_SOURCE_WEAK. At least one strong source needs to be added. Weaker sources (such as the cycle counter) can be used as a complement.
